Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Google Photos' "Similar photos are now automatically stacked" sheet - an auto-playing loop at the top of the sheet shows a photo grid collapsing into stacks with count badges.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A bottom sheet: a demo area at top separated from the text by a wavy torn-paper edge, the headline "Similar photos are now automatically stacked", explainer copy with a Learn more link, a blue OK button, and a "Turn off Photo stacks" text action.

## Motion spec
Pattern: looping photo-stack demo.
- The demo loops ~every 4s across several photo sets (selfies, dogs, landscapes): the grid of similar photos animates as each set's duplicates fly toward their best shot (translate + scale down to 0.85, 400ms, ease-in-out, 60ms stagger) and tuck behind it with a slight fan (each -3deg), a count badge ("8") popping onto the top card (scale 0 to 1, spring ~460/20).
- Hold stacked ~1s, then the stack fans back out to the grid (reverse paths, 350ms) and the next photo set crossfades in (300ms) to repeat.
- The wavy divider edge ripples subtly (+-2px, 3s) as the demo plays above it.
- Sheet entry: slides up with spring ~360/24; the demo starts playing 200ms after the sheet lands.
- OK dismisses with the sheet accelerating down (300ms); the demo halts immediately on dismiss start.

## Calibration
- The fly-to-stack paths arc slightly (20px vertical bow) so photos read as physical cards being gathered.
- The count badge is the payoff - it appears only after the last duplicate lands.

## Reduced motion
Demo shows before/after states crossfading; no flight paths.

## Don't miss
- The torn-paper wave edge between demo and text is the sheet's signature - keep it crisp.
- Duplicates tuck BEHIND the hero shot with visible edge offsets - the stack must read as a stack at rest.
